mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting glycolysis to aerobic ATP renewal was most worthwhile: the planned picture distinguishes fuel oxidation from oxygen's role and shows how the proton flow supports ATP synthesis.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was relatively predictable after installing the glucose carrier, though it prepared a useful comparison with passive transport.

surprise.text: The protein-building reaction automatically included the glycolytic cytosol; I expected amino acids and the ribosome-containing interior to suffice.

arbitrary.text: The automatic inclusion of glycolytic cytosol in protein production felt somewhat opaque: energy-coupling steps were marked, but the specific choice of that ingredient was not explained beforehand.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connect familiar cell biology to transport and energy use, though terms such as proton flow and ATP synthase could benefit from more explanation for this audience.
